messages:
maria: Quick design review: the rules builder preview has two UX pain points — priority handles feel ambiguous in compact mode, and the simulator validation badge is easy to miss. Who can take a look?
charlie: Noted. Priority handles look like drag handles but don't show hit area on hover. On small screens they overlap the chevrons. Screenshot attached. :mag: 
anya: Repro. The handle hitbox is 12px but our touch targets require 24px. We probably set the CSS accidentally when condensing cards.
kevin: For a quick fix we can increase the hit area with invisible padding and keep visual size. That avoids layout shifts. Will PR.
lydia: A11y: keyboard users can't see when a rule is the active reorder target. Need visible focus ring + aria-live updates when position changes. Also validation badge has insufficient contrast (AA fail).
sam: The simulator's validation badge currently says `2 issues`  product asked for clearer copy: `2 routing checks failed` and a tooltip explaining severity. Also the toast overlaps the preview controls on small widths.
charlie: Proposal: move the sim toast anchor to the bottom-left of preview pane and add an inline severity dot (red/yellow/gray). That should be less intrusive.
maria: UX microcopy: when a priority conflict occurs, current message is `Conflict detected`  too vague. Suggest: `Priority conflict: two rules target the same condition. Reorder or adjust conditions.`
anya: Will add that copy change to the validation flow and include a small inline action `Fix` that opens the conflicting rule in context.
kevin: I'll raise PR to bump hitbox, add focus ring, and re-anchor the toast. Also will add a small animation for the focus ring so keyboard nav is obvious.
lydia: For screenreaders: aria-live polite on reorder events, message format: `Rule 'chargeback' moved to position 2 of 5.` Also ensure role="status" on the validation container.
sam: For the simulator layout, suggest collapsing the legend under a toggle on <=760px and enabling vertical scroll for the heatmap so the control row never overlaps content.
charlie: Unit test note: add a test asserting handle hitbox is >=24px in condensed mode and screenshot regression for toast placement.
design-bot: Reminder: add design spec update (compact-mode handles + validation copy) and link Figma section 3.2. :white_check_mark:
maria: Timeline: aim to land copy + hitbox + focus-ring + toast anchor next week. Lydia will run SR test. Tagging for sprint planning. :rocket:
